_comment: Rights granted for SINTEL derivatives, by right and territory.
Sintel is CC BY 3.0, so the underlying work is cleared worldwide in
perpetuity -- that grant is real and is recorded as such. The music-cue
and stock-footage entries model the per-territory, windowed clearances a
commercial title actually carries, which is the shape this system has to
reason about. They are declared here rather than asserted anywhere in
code, and this file is reviewable in a diff.
See assets/SOURCES.md for the underlying licence.
